$comment: Routing, budget, and safety policy for the Shoulder autonomous build system. Model IDs are NOT listed here on purpose: lanes declare capability requirements and services/agentops/catalog.py picks the cheapest live model that meets them. Edit this file to change behaviour; do not edit the orchestrator.

autonomy.$comment_enabled: Master kill switch. The repository variable AUTONOMY_ENABLED overrides this at run time so autonomy can be stopped without a commit.
autonomy.$comment_phase_d: AGENTS.md rule 5 and the mandatory real-use gate forbid starting Task 23+ automatically. A human must clear the gate.

claude_subscription.$comment: AGENTS-level project policy: Claude is never the frontend implementation writer.
claude_subscription.privacy_basis: Anthropic commercial terms: prompts are not used for training.

codex_api.$comment: openai/codex-action@v1 authenticates with an API key only; ChatGPT subscription auth is not available to GitHub Actions. This lane therefore bills the OpenAI API.
codex_api.privacy_basis: OpenAI API platform terms: API data is not used for training by default.

openrouter.$comment: DeepSeek and other OpenRouter models are not permitted to write Shoulder frontend code under current project policy.
openrouter.privacy_basis: Enforced per request via provider.zdr and provider.data_collection=deny.

CHEAP_MECHANICAL.$comment: Ceiling admits the cheap tier of every family (Haiku-class, nano-class, flash-class) and excludes mid and frontier tiers.

privacy.$comment: Shoulder handles minors' data. Coding agents receive source, synthetic fixtures, and sanitised logs only -- never production footage, reflections, rows, or secrets. OpenRouter requests set provider.zdr and provider.data_collection accordingly; an endpoint that cannot satisfy these is ineligible at any price.

budget.$comment: Conservative starting ceilings chosen because the repository had no prior value. Raising them is a deliberate human edit; the orchestrator never raises a ceiling by itself. per_task_usd is checked before dispatch and again as spend is recorded.

qualification.$comment: A newly discovered model is CANDIDATE until it passes the synthetic suite, then QUALIFIED, or QUARANTINED on failure. Promotion happens only at a task boundary, never mid-task.
